info.about: Transformers: Fall of Cybertron is a third-person shooter video game based on the Transformers franchise, developed by High Moon Studios and published by Activision. It is the sequel to the 2010 video game Transformers: War for Cybertron, and directly follows the events of that game, as the Autobots struggle to defeat their Decepticon foes in a civil war for their home planet of Cybertron.
info.trivia: Peter Cullen returned as Optimus Prime and Gregg Berger as Grimlock, reprising their roles from the 1984 animated series.
info.why: It was delisted from digital storefronts after the licensing deal between Activision and Hasbro expired.
